Intralayer links: color, weight filter and arrowheads

Source: R/mira_pieces.R
mira_intralayer.Rd

Styles the links within layers: color by a link column (color_by) or one constant (color), hide weak links (min_weight), size arrowheads (arrow_size). Add it to a plot made with mira().

Usage

mira_intralayer(
  color_by,
  color,
  min_weight,
  arrow_size,
  color_values,
  color_scale,
  color_palette,
  color_reverse,
  color_limits
)

Arguments

color_by

Link column to color intralayer links by (a column of net$extended, e.g. "type"; not weight, which sets the links' width). NULL or NA = default.

color

A constant link color: a color name or "#rrggbb". Give color_by or color, not both.

min_weight

Hide links with weight below this value (0 or more, in the units of the data's weight column).

arrow_size

Arrowhead size, between 0 and 3 (1 = MiRA's default). Directed networks only. MiRA has one arrowhead size, so this also sizes the arrowheads of directed interlayer links.

color_values

Colors for values of the color_by column, named by value. See mira_scales.

color_scale

"categorical" or "continuous". See mira_scales.

color_palette

A named palette for the color_by scale: categorical ("Okabe-Ito", ...) or continuous ("magma", ...); see mira_scales for the list.

color_reverse

TRUE reverses the palette.

color_limits

c(min, max): the gradient runs from min to max instead of the data's range; values outside take the end colors. Gives a continuous scale.

Value

A component, to add to a plot with +.

See also

mira_interlayer() for the links between layers; mira_scales for color_values and color_scale.

Other components: mira_camera(), mira_filter(), mira_interlayer(), mira_layer(), mira_layout(), mira_legends(), mira_mode, mira_mode_dashboard(), mira_mode_data(), mira_mode_grid(), mira_mode_layer(), mira_mode_map(), mira_mode_meta(), mira_node()

Examples

library(emln)
net <- load_emln(17) # 4 layers; bird and plant nodes
#> Creating state node map
#> Creating extended link list with node IDs
p <- mira(net, bipartite = TRUE, setA_type = "bird")
#> Bipartite network: drawn as undirected. Use directed = TRUE for a directed one.

# Color by a link column
p + mira_intralayer(color_by = "type")
#> Not opened: R is not interactive. Print the plot in an R session, or give `browser` to open it from a script.

# One color; hide links with weight below 0.05
p + mira_intralayer(color = "grey60", min_weight = 0.05)
#> Not opened: R is not interactive. Print the plot in an R session, or give `browser` to open it from a script.

# Choose the colors (see ?mira_scales)
p + mira_intralayer(color_by = "type", color_values = c(pollination = "#d62728"))
#> Not opened: R is not interactive. Print the plot in an R session, or give `browser` to open it from a script.
p + mira_intralayer(color_by = "type", color_scale = "categorical")
#> Not opened: R is not interactive. Print the plot in an R session, or give `browser` to open it from a script.

# Arrowheads, on a directed network
mira(net, bipartite = TRUE, setA_type = "bird", directed = TRUE) +
  mira_intralayer(arrow_size = 0.5)
#> Not opened: R is not interactive. Print the plot in an R session, or give `browser` to open it from a script.
